claims.quote: Described from '18 miles east of Kuching, Sarawak state, Borneo, East Malaysia' and apparently endemic to western Borneo with a range extending into the Indonesian province of West Kalimantan (Kalimantan Barat) where it's known from the Kapuas River system, including the lake system of Danau Sentarum.

regions.name: Borneo
regions.quote: The false spanner barb, Barbodes kuchingensis, is a cyprinid apparently endemic to western Borneo, from Sarawak into the Kapuas system.
